Create a renderer

Source: R/constructors.R
new_renderer.Rd

Builds a renderer to hand to add_renderer(). type picks which kind and ... sets that kind's properties, so this is one function instead of remembering which class goes with which symbology.

Usage

new_renderer(type = "simple", ...)

Arguments

type

default "simple". Defines which renderer to build, either "simple" or "unique-value".

...

Defines the renderer's properties, all named. See ISimpleRenderer and IUniqueValueRenderer for what each kind takes.

Value

An ISimpleRenderer or an IUniqueValueRenderer.

Details

A "simple" renderer draws every feature the same way, optionally varying colour by a colorInfo visual variable. A "unique-value" renderer draws one symbol per value of a field.

Examples

new_renderer("simple", symbol = new_symbol("marker", color = "red"))
#> <arcgisviz::ISimpleRenderer>
#>  @ type              : chr "simple"
#>  @ symbol            : <arcgisviz::ISimpleMarkerSymbol>
#>  .. @ type   : chr "esriSMS"
#>  .. @ style  : <arcgisviz::SimpleMarkerSymbolStyle>
#>  .. .. @ value   : chr "esriSMSCircle"
#>  .. .. @ variants: chr [1:6] "esriSMSCircle" "esriSMSCross" "esriSMSDiamond" ...
#>  .. .. @ allow_na: logi TRUE
#>  .. @ color  : <arcgisviz::Color>
#>  .. .. @ r: num 255
#>  .. .. @ g: num 0
#>  .. .. @ b: num 0
#>  .. .. @ a: num 255
#>  .. @ size   : num NA
#>  .. @ outline: NULL
#>  .. @ angle  : num NA
#>  .. @ xoffset: num NA
#>  .. @ yoffset: num NA
#>  @ visualVariables   : list()
#>  @ label             : chr NA
#>  @ description       : chr NA
#>  @ rotationExpression: chr NA
#>  @ rotationType      : <arcgisviz::IRendererRotationType>
#>  .. @ value   : chr NA
#>  .. @ variants: chr [1:2] "arithmetic" "geographic"
#>  .. @ allow_na: logi TRUE

new_renderer("unique-value", field1 = "species")
#> <arcgisviz::IUniqueValueRenderer>
#>  @ type            : chr "uniqueValue"
#>  @ field1          : chr "species"
#>  @ field2          : chr NA
#>  @ field3          : chr NA
#>  @ fieldDelimiter  : chr NA
#>  @ defaultSymbol   : NULL
#>  @ defaultLabel    : chr NA
#>  @ uniqueValueInfos: list()
#>  @ legendOptions   : NULL
